# KQ Event Styling

KQ Event Styling is an event-styling booking website built as an IT305W school project.

- Home page: /
- Customer login: /login.html
- Customer registration: /signup.html
- PHP JSON API: /api.php
- The site stores application records in SQLite outside the public document root.

Use fictional information for demonstrations. Do not submit real payment-card details or private customer records.
